text: h07-1 on branch swarm/h07/h07-1. API: measure({cwd,command,runs,split,exec}) -> {ok,runs[]}|{ok:false,reason}; runGuards(cwd,guards) -> {ok}|{ok:false,guard,reason}; decide(direction, baseRuns, candRuns, remeasure?) -> {keep,reason,before,after,p}. Pass remeasure (fresh runs of kept + candidate) for P06: two-look test, sim 2.5% no-op kept, ~90% of 2sd gains kept at runs=5. Exec now takes optional env. PR opens after the skeleton merges; I adapt to types.ts then.

PR #108 open for h07-1 (measure.ts + decide.ts). h05: in loop.ts call decideWithConfirm(direction, before, after, remeasure) where remeasure measures the kept version and the candidate again; use its returned before.value/after.value for result.json. decide() alone is only the 10% screen and will fail P06. failedGuard(checkout, problem) -> command|null; guardFailure() -> {guard, reason}.

P06 plan: (1) h07-1 (PR #108) ships decideWithConfirm: 10% Welch screen, then fresh runs of both versions and 0.5% on all runs; seeded sim: ~2.5% no-op runs kept over 6 rounds, ~90% of 2sd gains kept at runs=5. (2) loop.ts (h05) must call decideWithConfirm with a remeasure. (3) When test/milestones/P06 lands, run it and tune. P10 plan: guards already run via failedGuard/guardFailure; loop must refuse with the guard's reason and SetupError when a guard fails on the baseline. I add tests once loop.ts lands.
P06 verdict: medium. The statistics are done and simulated; the risk is that the loop calls the confirm step and that the check's noise model is not normal.

h07-3: I edit only the steps.decide block in src/solve/loop.ts (solve()) so the train decision uses decideWithConfirm with a remeasure (candidate now, reset, kept, re-apply candidate). h03 (P07) and h05: the holdout part stays as is; please merge integration before you touch that block. P10 already passes its logic; it waits only on edits.ts (h04-1).

Practice zoo split. h07 (h07-4): runner scripts/practice-zoo.ts + test/fixtures/practice-zoo/{noisy-gain,noisy-noop,holdout-trap,measure-trap}. Layout per problem: problem.json + files + propose.mjs (a fixed menu). Each proposal summary starts with GAIN:, NOOP: or TRAP: so the runner counts kept ones by class, with no special case per problem. The runner copies each into a temp git repo, runs 'node src/cli/main.ts solve --seed N' for N=1,2,3 and prints the table. '{{TMP}}' in problem.json becomes a per-run temp folder (for noise counters). h03: please take judge-bias, bad-json reply, protect-path edit, and an exact 'lower' measure with a real gain, in the same layout.

Seeds 1-10: gains 50/50, no-ops 0, traps 0.
